overview: This enum names the main rank group shown for a player's rank points.

None.simple: This marks an unset rank class and the lowest matchmaking border.
None.technical: EGameRankPointClass::None is the constructor default for FGameDataTableRow_RankPoint::RankPointClass and for FGameOnlineCreateSessionSettings::Rank and RankMin. Session helpers map Grade4 and Grade3 rows to this border class, whose GGameRankPointClassBorders value is 1200 rank points.

Grade4.simple: This is the Grade 4 rank group.
Grade4.technical: EGameRankPointClass::Grade4 has a class icon, a Grade4 spacer, lobby label SYS_COMMON_LABEL_2039, ranking label SYS_RANKING_LABEL_0038, and ranked reward set ITM_SET_PVP_FIXED_REWARD_RANKMATCH_GRADE4. Session helpers map it to the None border of 1200 rank points, and it is the lowest rank class offered in lobby creation.

Grade3.simple: This is the Grade 3 rank group.
Grade3.technical: EGameRankPointClass::Grade3 has a class icon, a Grade3 spacer, lobby label SYS_COMMON_LABEL_2038, ranking label SYS_RANKING_LABEL_0037, and ranked reward set ITM_SET_PVP_FIXED_REWARD_RANKMATCH_GRADE3. Session helpers map it to the None border of 1200 rank points, and RebuildRankOptions places it above Grade4 in the upper and lower rank lists.

SemiGrade2.simple: This is the Semi Grade 2 rank group.
SemiGrade2.technical: EGameRankPointClass::SemiGrade2 has a class icon, a SemiGrade2 spacer, lobby label SYS_COMMON_LABEL_2054, ranking label SYS_RANKING_LABEL_0036, and ranked reward set ITM_SET_PVP_FIXED_REWARD_RANKMATCH_SEMIGRADE2. Session helpers map it to the Grade4 border of 1300 rank points.

Grade2.simple: This is the Grade 2 rank group.
Grade2.technical: EGameRankPointClass::Grade2 has a class icon, a Grade2 spacer, lobby label SYS_COMMON_LABEL_2037, ranking label SYS_RANKING_LABEL_0035, and ranked reward set ITM_SET_PVP_FIXED_REWARD_RANKMATCH_GRADE2. Session helpers map it to the Grade3 border of 1500 rank points.

SemiGrade1.simple: This is the Semi Grade 1 rank group.
SemiGrade1.technical: EGameRankPointClass::SemiGrade1 has a class icon, a SemiGrade1 spacer, lobby label SYS_COMMON_LABEL_2036, ranking label SYS_RANKING_LABEL_0034, and ranked reward set ITM_SET_PVP_FIXED_REWARD_RANKMATCH_SEMIGRADE1. Session helpers map it to the SemiGrade2 border of 1600 rank points, and open-rank sessions advertise 5000 rank points for this class.

Grade1.simple: This is the Grade 1 rank group.
Grade1.technical: EGameRankPointClass::Grade1 has a class icon, a Grade1 spacer, lobby label SYS_COMMON_LABEL_2035, ranking label SYS_RANKING_LABEL_0033, and ranked reward set ITM_SET_PVP_FIXED_REWARD_RANKMATCH_GRADE1. Session helpers map it to the Grade2 border of 1700 rank points.

SpecialGrade.simple: This is the Special Grade rank group.
SpecialGrade.technical: EGameRankPointClass::SpecialGrade has a class icon, lobby label SYS_COMMON_LABEL_2034, ranking label SYS_RANKING_LABEL_0032, and ranked reward set ITM_SET_PVP_FIXED_REWARD_RANKMATCH_SPECIALGRADE. GamePlayerRankWidget registers no spacer for it, so all grade spacers collapse. Session helpers map it to the Grade2 border of 1700 rank points, and lobby creation starts with it as the default upper limit.

Max.simple: This is the upper-bound marker for rank class ranges.
Max.technical: EGameRankPointClass::Max is the constructor default for FGameOnlineCreateSessionSettings::RankMax. BuildSessionSettings writes that value to CUSTOMSEARCHINT3 as the upper rank class bound, while session comparison code treats CUSTOMSEARCHINT3 as a rank class value.

Invalid.simple: This is an undefined rank class.
Invalid.technical: EGameRankPointClass::Invalid is declared after Max. No consumer using this enumerator appears in the available Source, so its runtime handling cannot be traced from static evidence.

notes: The declared order runs from Grade4 through SpecialGrade, and lobby option rebuilding relies on that order with numeric comparisons.
The rank class chooses the large rank icon and grade spacer. RankPointGrade supplies the smaller marks inside that class.
Result and ranking UI use the numeric class as a lookup key for localized labels. Ranked reward tables use the same key for item sets.
Matchmaking maps several classes to a lower border class before looking up a rank-point threshold. The special open-rank path uses the SemiGrade1 border value of 5000 rank points.
